originalTitle: Brendan Carr says he’ll let Pete Hegseth decide whether TV networks can air the public execution

content: FCC chairman Brendan Carr said he will defer to Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth on whether TV networks can air the planned execution of convicted Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan by firing squad. The Pentagon has said the execution will be livestreamed, suggesting it’ll appear on an online platform beyond the FCC’s jurisdiction. But it’s common for broadcast TV networks to air live video of government events, and Carr’s agency does have a say over what happens on public airwaves. “My understanding is it’s not on broadcast TV, so I don’t think there’s a role for the FCC one way or the other,” Carr said in a CNBC interview today. “But I trust Secretary Hegseth. He’s implemented the laws and the regulations that are relevant to the Department of War, and I think he’s doing a great job, and I trust that he’s making the right call on these issues.” When asked if the execution would be allowed on broadcast TV if the Defense Department wanted it, Carr said it would be Hegseth’s choice. “Ultimately we’re going to defer to Secretary Hegseth and his decisions on how to move forward with this,” Carr said. The Verge has asked major tech companies whether they will allow the execution livestream on their platforms. As of this writing, YouTube, Twitch, Meta, and X haven’t responded to requests for comment.

chineseContent: FCC 主席布伦丹·卡尔 (Brendan Carr) 表示，他将听从国防部长皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 的意见，决定电视网络是否可以播放行刑队计划对胡德堡枪手尼达尔·哈桑 (Nidal Hasan) 执行死刑的情况。五角大楼表示，执行过程将进行直播，这意味着执行过程将出现在联邦通信委员会管辖范围之外的在线平台上。但广播电视网络直播政府活动的视频是很常见的，卡尔的机构确实对公共广播中发生的事情有发言权。卡尔今天在接受 CNBC 采访时表示：“我的理解是，这不会出现在广播电视上，所以我认为 FCC 无论如何都没有作用。” “但我信任赫格斯部长。他执行了与战争部相关的法律和法规，我认为他做得很好，我相信他在这些问题上做出了正确的决定。”当被问及如果国防部愿意，是否会在广播电视上允许执行死刑时，卡尔表示，这将是赫格塞斯的选择。卡尔说：“最终我们将听从赫格斯部长和他关于如何推进这一工作的决定。” The Verge 已询问主要科技公司是否允许在其平台上直播执行。截至撰写本文时，YouTube、Twitch、Meta 和 X 尚未回复置评请求。
